input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 satisfies the preferred position in full: audits are limited to once in any twelve-month period, require thirty days' prior written notice, occur during normal business hours, are conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly (§ 22.2). Section 23 imposes no parallel audit obligation on us, and no remote-access, telemetry or verification right binding Customer appears elsewhere. No redline required.
